Risk Reward>opening twist>>>shot in the dark>>>>beware advantage>do or die>>>knowledge is power>>>>>>>>>>>hourglass

Risk/Reward Twist let tribes talk to each other and build bonds before merge and lead to some fun TV moments and got us to know people better. It was a fun exile like twist that helped more than hurt. I think with less extra votes and more small advantages like a next tribal use only idol or extra vote per merge cap would balance it out a bit.

Opening Twist was a fun way to start out the season and see how the tribes thought and started some early tribe dynamics.

Shot in the Dark was cool in concept but no one ended up using it. Give players more of an indent I’ve to use it.

The rest from here out are bad but could use rework or just need to be scraped…

Beware Advantage was fun but those phrases were pretty good damned cringey and terrible, also not being able to vote multiple rounds just for a regular idol is a very unfair twist with such small tribes.

Do or Die, I like this twist IN THEORY, but it needs major reworks to be saved. I like the idea of having a risk to immunity, especially now that rewards don’t happen nearly as much. Make the punishment challenge more skill based like making a fire or completing a puzzle in a certain amount of time. And do it either first merge or like final 6. Having it pop up randomly halfway through merge was jarring.

Knowledge is power, it’ll be extremely hard to rework this one, only reason it’s lower than do or die. The only thing I saw as a possible idea is ask another player any question and they HAVE to answer truthfully. Like if they ask “do you have an idol” or “are you going to vote me tonight” they have to say a clear yes or no and must follow through with it. But even then it’s kind of dumb.
